technique_name: Write an article about the current environmental conditions in your hometown.
description: London is one of the largest cities in the world and is home to millions of people. Unfortunately, air pollution remains a significant issue in the city. Recently, the city has implemented more stringent regulations designed to reduce emissions from vehicles, factories, and other sources.
